evidence.quote:
A rollback
we have not rehearsed is a rollback we do not actually have.

observations.why: Frames rehearsal as the condition for genuinely possessing a capability — security through preparation and competence through verified readiness.
Cadence language appeals to stability and security through recurring, scheduled practice.

mints.name: UnrehearsedCapabilityIsNoCapability
mints.title: a capability we have not rehearsed is a capability we do not actually have
mints.frame: Is the value appeal here equating possession of a capability with having verified it through rehearsal, rather than merely claiming it exists?
